_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Personnel Recruitment Advertising Management Plan
summary: The plan describes the contractor's organization, assignment of functions, duties and responsibilities, management procedures and policies, and reporting requirements for a personnel recruitment advertising program.
use_relationship:
The plan describes the contractor's organization, assignment of functions, duties and responsibilities, management procedures and policies, and reporting requirements for the conduct of a personnel recruitment advertising program.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID is used in contracts for recruitment advertising services whose day-to-day management is under the direction and control of the contractor.

This DID is used in conjunction with DI-MISC-81311A, Personnel recruitment Advertisement and DI-MISC-81312A, Collateral Personnel Recruitment Literature.

This DID supersede DI-MISC-81310.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan may be typewritten or printed on standard size paper, e.g., 8 1/2 x 11" or metric size A4. The pages shall be sequentially numbered and securely bound together. As necessary, graphic material may be one-way foldouts. All attachments shall be identified and referenced in the text. Each section and paragraph shall be numbered. The document shall be legible and reproducible. The plan may be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The personnel Recruitment advertising plan shall consist of the organizational structure, the assignment of functions, duties, and responsibilities, the procedures and policies, and the reporting requirements that are established for the initiation, monitoring, control and reporting of contractual tasks specified in the contract statement of work (SOW).

children.title: Organizational structure.
children.content: An organizational chart with supporting narrative portraying the contractor's business (corporate) structure. It shall describe the functional relationships and responsibilities among the organizational elements that will participate in the accomplishment of the personnel recruitment advertising program.

children.title: The plan shall list the personnel staffing
children.content: The plan shall list the personnel staffing of the contractor's management office that directs the contractual tasks, projects, and programs and assist in completing the Contract. The listing shall include the education, training, skills, experience, and Security clearance (if applicable) that personnel require to fill each position and shall State a identify, background, and work experience of the personnel assigned to fill these positions.

children.title: The plan shall also describe the staffing required
children.content: The plan shall also describe the staffing required for proper accomplishment of each contractual tasks by skill type, skill level and number of personnel. When submitted as part of a proposal; the plan shall state how many such personnel are currently available and how many sub-contractor personnel are required to staff fully to accomplish each task as scheduled.

preparation_instructions.title: Program Management.
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall present an organizational chart and supporting narrative describing the management office the contractor establishes to manage the contractual commitments.

children.title: The plan shall define the direct lines
children.content: The plan shall define the direct lines of control, responsibilities, functional relationships, and authority between the management office and the contractor's other organizational elements. The plan shall also describe all interfaces between the contractor and the Government and between the contractor and other contractors which are necessary and pertinent to the accomplishment of the personnel recruitment advertising program.

children.title: The plan shall include a narrative description
children.content: The plan shall include a narrative description of the technical advertising strategy approach and media methods the contractor will employ to accomplish contractual tasks, including as applicable, objectives, results expected, problems/proposed solutions, ability to meet short deadlines and other special aspects attendant to Government recruiting. The plan shall include a milestone chart graphically depicting the schedule of events associated with accomplishing each contractual commitment.

children.title: Identification.
children.content: The plan shall be identified with the preparing office or contractor's title, the identifying numbers of designation of the contract/procurement request, the identify and nomenclature of the program/project, and the Government activity issuing the controlling contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Other Media Advertising Requirements.
preparation_instructions.content: The contractor may address other creative and innovative media requirements in the plan, over and above the more common print and broadcast media, as deemed appropriate to meet the Government goals of the recruitment advertising program.

children.title: The plan shall describe the management methods
children.content: The plan shall describe the management methods the contractor will employ to ensure meeting all preparations, format, and submittal requirements established by the Contract Data Requirement List (CDRL) (DD Form 1423) for data to be Delivered to the Government.

preparation_instructions.title: Descriptive Material.
preparation_instructions.content: As may be needed to clarify or explain matters in the text, the plan may include descriptive material, sketches, drawings, photographs, tables, forms, graphs, worksheets, charts, etc.
